title: Sitar Legend Forever - Hard
description: Sitar Legend Forever - Hard — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A //TEMP

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 5, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Hard mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_A //TEMP

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 5, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Hard mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

Well, I have to give you some credit. You beat Sitar Hero on Hard, which takes some serious skill or perhaps forty years of Sitar lessons. If you really enjoyed playing on Hard you can give it another shot as many times as you like!

The teleporter to play Sitar Hero on Hard is in Mutanous Malaise, Level 5. The creatures there have been waiting impatiently for some time to get their turn, so fighting them for your turn should be entertaining. Return to me, Gee Dubya Shrub, here in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine when you have beaten Sitar Hero on Hard.

Turn-in:

Wow, you look like you just got done running a marathon! The sweat is pouring off of you. You know what you need? A headband! And some leather pants. Wait, those seem conterproductive... Which... must... mean... IT WOULD ROCK! Let me know if you want to play Sitar Hero again, with or without the leather pants and headband, on Hard.

Objectives:

  • 10 Polkadot Notes ×10
  • 10 Plaid Notes ×10
  • 10 Paisley Notes ×10
  • 10 Leopard Notes ×10

Client level range: 33–55
